tools.name: schema
tools.description: Free catalog of input fields, returned parameter names (what each code like NT or IP0 means), defect codes, and error codes. Does not spend quota.

tools.name: first_shot
tools.description: Recommend a first-shot process. Costs 1 call. Required: polymer.polymer_abbreviation, mold.product_ave_thickness, machine.injector.injector_screw_diameter_mm.

tools.name: optimize
tools.description: Adjust the current process for one defect. Costs 1 call. Required: defect_info with desc set to an engine code, and current_params.
